subject: Evernorth Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: XRPN; warrants: XRPNW)
purpose: Separate realized cash, cash deployed to buy XRP, XRP contributed in kind, debt drawn, conditional equity-line capacity, warrant exercise capacity and financing fees. Preserve filing inconsistencies and unverified draw/payment status.
scope: Public SEC filings only; no private accounts, nonpublic issuer data or unauthorized access.

source_independence.issuer_filings: The 8-K, S-1 and 424B3 are separate filings by the same issuer and are not independent issuer confirmations.
source_independence.sec_effect: The EFFECT notice is an SEC administrative record confirming registration effectiveness, not confirmation of an ELOC purchase or draw.
source_independence.independent_corroboration: No independent bank, transfer-agent, Cantor settlement or custodian confirmation was located in this research pass.

facts: Purchase Agreement with CF Principal Investments LLC (Cantor) dated 2026-10-23
Issuer may elect to sell up to 5,218,935 newly issued Class A shares
Purchase price generally 97% of applicable VWAP
20% trading-volume and 4.99% beneficial-ownership constraints
$521,893.50 upfront commitment fee; payment timing follows effectiveness of the resale registration statement
Up to 5,218,935 shares may be issued and sold by Evernorth to Cantor at issuer discretion
Cantor's subsequent resale proceeds belong to Cantor, not Evernorth
Prospectus scenario states up to approximately $76.8 million gross and $74.4 million net over approximately 14 months at the stated reference price and estimated costs
Evernorth may sell all, some or none of the shares
Commencement requires satisfaction or waiver of all Section 7.2 conditions, not merely registration effectiveness
Upfront commitment fee is $521,893.50, fully earned and non-refundable regardless of whether purchases occur
Initial ELOC resale registration statement effective 2026-10-30
Evernorth unrestricted cash $0.1 million and net working capital deficit $696.1 million as of 2026-06-30
Pubco borrowed $9.7 million under the $10 million Ripple intercompany facility as of 2026-10-07
Pubco reports $214.1 million cash raised under private placement subscriptions and 84,365,876 XRP purchased with that cash
Approximately 473 million XRP held as of 2026-10-09

At closing, gross cash proceeds approximately $272.6 million before transaction expenses, including approximately $224.6 million private placements and $48.0 million trust-account release after redemptions
Investors contributed approximately 388,910,554 XRP in kind
Up to 11,499,992 Class A shares issuable upon exercise of Public Warrants
Each Public Warrant has an $11.50 cash exercise price
Issuer receives proceeds only upon cash exercise; registration is not evidence of exercise

evidence_excerpt_hashes.hash_basis: SHA-256 of the normalized text excerpts retained in this artifact, not the full SEC HTML or HTTP wire bytes.

event_timeline.event: Pubco reports $9.7M drawn under a $10M Ripple intercompany facility; debt, not equity proceeds.
Business combination closes; issuer reports approximately 473M XRP held, including in-kind contributions and cash-funded XRP purchases.
Evernorth warrant POS AM filed; up to 11,499,992 shares issuable on $11.50 cash exercise.
Evernorth enters optional committed equity purchase agreement with Cantor for up to 5,218,935 newly issued shares.
ELOC resale registration becomes effective; final 424B3 prospectus filed.
SEC EFFECT notice accepted; it records the 2026-10-30 effectiveness date.
Research capture; no ELOC Commencement Date, VWAP Purchase Notice, Cantor share purchase or settled proceeds verified in the reviewed primary records.

eloc.issuer_discretion: all, some or none; issuer has no obligation to sell the full commitment

limits.trading_volume_cap_exception: only if Evernorth and Cantor expressly agree to a higher percentage
limits.threshold_price: greater of $1.00, 90% of prior close, and any higher price specified by Evernorth

eloc.term: through the first day of the month following the 14-month anniversary of the 2026-10-23 agreement, unless earlier terminated

proceeds_scenarios.scenario_status: illustrative conditional capacity, not actual proceeds

upfront_commitment_fee.payment_deadline_rule: within five business days after the Upfront Determination Date, defined as the SEC effectiveness date
upfront_commitment_fee.classification: contractual fee/expense, not capital raised and not XRP purchase funding

dilution.classification: potential XRPN equity dilution if fully issued; not XRP token dilution

prospectus_internal_inconsistency.status: unresolved; preserve rather than silently normalize
prospectus_internal_inconsistency.interpretation: The $14.71 row displays approximately the undiscounted gross value while the footnote says the table uses 97% of assumed trading price. The cover/use-of-proceeds section separately gives approximately $76.8M gross and $74.4M net. Do not treat the inconsistent row as an independent amount or as actual proceeds.

eloc.use_of_proceeds_intent: general corporate purposes, including XRP acquisition and XRP-ecosystem activity, and working capital; issuer says a substantial portion of any proceeds is expected for additional XRP, but this is intent and not an obligation.

warrants.classification: contingent warrant exercise capacity; not actual cash raised

capital_reconciliation.transaction_expenses: gross closing cash is before transaction expenses; do not call it net cash available
capital_reconciliation.overlap_rule: The $214.1M private-placement cash is part of the broader closing financing picture; do not add it to the $224.6M private-placement total or $272.6M gross closing proceeds. The 388.91M in-kind XRP and 84.365M cash-purchased XRP reconcile to approximately 473M XRP holdings; do not add the separately described 261.919M 'Pubco XRP' subtotal again without a documented non-overlap bridge.
capital_reconciliation.xrp_in_kind_overlap_rule: The prospectus separately describes 261,919,096 XRP associated with Private Placement Subscription Agreements and 388,910,554 XRP contributed in kind at closing. Treat the 261,919,096 as a separately reported subtotal whose overlap with the total in-kind figure requires an agreement-level bridge; do not add the figures. The 388,910,554 in-kind total plus 84,365,876 cash-purchased XRP reconciles to approximately 473M holdings.

scenarios_and_counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: Evernorth may use some or all ELOC capacity to fund XRP purchases.
scenarios_and_counter_hypotheses.evidence_for: The prospectus says a substantial portion of any proceeds is expected to acquire XRP.
scenarios_and_counter_hypotheses.evidence_against: Issuer can elect all, some or none; no Commencement Date, purchase notice, share issuance or settled proceeds verified; proceeds may also fund general corporate purposes and working capital.

scenarios_and_counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: The ELOC may create XRPN share-supply/dilution pressure.
scenarios_and_counter_hypotheses.evidence_for: Up to 5.219M new shares, approximately 16.7% of post-issue Class A shares if fully issued; purchases are at a discount to VWAP.
scenarios_and_counter_hypotheses.evidence_against: No issuance or resale amount verified; volume, price, beneficial ownership and other conditions restrict purchases.

scenarios_and_counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: Public warrant exercises could generate additional cash.
scenarios_and_counter_hypotheses.evidence_for: Up to 11.5M shares at $11.50 cash exercise price.
scenarios_and_counter_hypotheses.evidence_against: Actual exercise counts and cash receipts not verified; registration alone does not mean warrants were exercised.

model_admission.reason: Financing capacity, fees, cash balances, debt and XRP holdings are separate accounting/event variables. No actual ELOC draw or warrant exercise was verified. Do not treat these capacities as realized XRP demand or cash flows.
required_future_evidence: ELOC Commencement Date or issuer confirmation of condition satisfaction/waiver
VWAP Purchase Notices and shares issued to Cantor
settlement confirmations or subsequent SEC disclosures of gross/net proceeds
warrant exercise counts and cash proceeds
subsequent XRP purchases and wallet/treasury reconciliation

research_limitations.latest_filing_search_scope: SEC filings indexed and surfaced in this pass through 2026-11-08
